name: Volume breakout
idea: A signal when a volume surge drives the close to or through the top or bottom of the recent range; the idea is wrong just beyond the level that must hold.

params.label: Volume surge
params.help: The bar's volume must be at least this many times the average (this template needs volume: indices have none).

params.label: Range bars
params.help: How many bars before the surge make the recent range.

params.label: Level buffer
params.help: How many average true ranges beyond the level that must hold (the range edge, or the surge bar's own extreme when the close did not clear the edge).
